settings.subheading: EARN POINTS WITH EVERY PURCHASE AND GET REWARDED

settings.heading: How to Use Your Rewards App on Our Online Store
1. Log In or Sign Up
settings.description:
• Click the rewards icon at the bottom left of your screen to sign in.
  • If you don’t have an account, create one using the same email you use for purchases. This ensures you collect all your points and avoid losing any.

settings.heading: 2. How to Earn Points
settings.description:
• Sign Up: 200 Points
  • Place an Order: 2 Points for every R1 spent
  • Like Us on Facebook: 100 Points
  • Follow Us on Instagram: 100 Points

settings.heading: 3. Redeeming Your Points
settings.description:
• Log in and refresh your screen if needed.
  • Click “Ways to Redeem” and then “Redeem.”
  • Choose how many points you want to use (100 Points = R3). You can use only one code per order.
  • Click “Apply Code” to automatically apply the discount at checkout. Alternatively, copy the discount code and enter it at checkout.
  • The discount code is valid for 6 months from date of issue.
